title: Playtest version of my German Language Learning Game is now out :)
author: jewlzs_
selftext:
I made a game that aims to help people with their vocabulary learning, using the German CERF levels to help beginner to advanced learners use spaced repetition language learning with a more gameified learning experience. The main features of the game include:

* complete vocabulary lists for A1 (beginner) - C1 (advanced) learners to learn German
* multiple-choice, flashcard, or cloze style learning cards
* strengthen article recognition for vocabulary you're already learning
* strengthen preposition + verb recognition for vocabulary you're already learning
* memory-style mini-game for reviewing your learned vocabulary with a different twist
* earn items and decorate your cafe, making it uniquely yours
* leaderboards to see how you fair with the other players in real time

In terms of the AI use and non-use for it:

* AI did a lot of the coding and i used [rosebud.ai](http://rosebud.ai) . it was interesting to note that before it came out for playtesting i had to comb through the code manually to take out a lot of dialogue since the AI really loved over explaining or putting too much text in everything
* i used VoiceTTS for the pronunciation of the German words. originally it would use the default browser TTS but it was just not good 😅
* it helped to clean a lot of the vocabulary data, like adding the definite article for nouns or make the thing that would let the code know when to put gaps for the cloze answers. i had to double-check it all and there was still a lot of manual cleaning, but it was definitely a lot faster and easier with AI supporting me (for this i used Kimi K). the game has around 6000\~ words and I wanted high quality, unified data
* i did the assets myself, i had a style for this game i was set on doing

You can try the trial version [here](https://languagelearningcafe.itch.io/trial-learngermancafe) and if you want to playtest and have access to all the vocabulary available in the game, please dm me. I would also love to hear feedback on it as well.  I would like to eventually release it on Steam and on mobile, but I heard they have a bit of a learning curve since there are developer programs I have to join and what not.

I also tried to record the audio but it wasn't working :'D

comments.author: Acidswtf
comments.body: Also es triggert mich dass beim eintippen die Zeile springt. Und selbst als deutscher finde ich die Aufgaben weird. Und ohne TTS kann man das glaube ich kompeltt vergessen. Notfalls hol dir ein elevenlabs abo die haben extrem gute deutsche vertonung vorallem für kürzere sachen.

replies.author: jewlzs_
replies.body:

Und die Aufgaben wie Artikel und Verben + Präpositionen Training, ich meine ja, du brauchst das nicht du bist ein deutscher 😅
